name: SpeakFlow
description: Local and cloud speech-to-text for Windows.

showcase.headline: Speak naturally. Keep your flow.
showcase.intro: Hold a hotkey, speak, then release. SpeakFlow turns your words into text in the app you're already using, with local and cloud recognition options.
features: Choose local or cloud speech recognition
showcase.imageAlt: SpeakFlow's dark dictation workspace with recording controls and a transcript panel.
showcase.imageCaption: Published workspace preview · may differ from the downloadable version.

name: Cinder
description: Your coding-agent usage stats, on your desktop.

showcase.headline: See where your agent usage goes.
showcase.intro: Cinder brings your coding-agent activity into one desktop view. Explore requests, tokens, and available cost estimates from local logs instead of piecing them together across tools.
features: Read coding-agent logs on your machine
Inspect local data sources and check for updates
showcase.imageAlt: Cinder's official blue bar-chart app icon.
showcase.imageCaption: Official application artwork · interface screenshot to come.

name: Everglow Desktop
description: Everglow in a dedicated Windows app, with its own browser profile.

showcase.headline: A dedicated home for Everglow.
showcase.intro: The Everglow website, in its own Windows application. Keep a separate sign-in profile and use desktop controls without keeping another browser tab open.
features: Desktop update checks built into the app
showcase.imageAlt: Everglow's purple sign-in screen with a numeric keypad.
showcase.imageCaption: Actual sign-in screen · shown before authentication.
